evidence.detail: The class owns exactly fifteen public static java.awt.Color constants initialized from fixed RGB/RGBA tuples and has no other mutable application state or behavior.

Exact-v308 consumers span LauncherSidePanel, ItemSearchSidebarPanel, SwingDesktopUiSupport, loadout/PvP/developer/sidebar components and custom Swing controls, establishing it as a shared GUI palette rather than one feature's colors.
The class exposes only color constants and an empty constructor; it performs no rendering, layout, networking or gameplay mutation.

evidence.detail: Launcher constructs exactly one rs/gui/E in field n, sizes it to the 765x503 base game dimension, gives it BorderLayout and a black background.
Launcher initializes/starts the live Client and then adds that Client component directly to rs/gui/E at BorderLayout.CENTER.
The outer launcher panel adds rs/gui/E beside the R357 LauncherSidePanel before packing the R354 LauncherWindowFrame, proving E is the dedicated embedded game-client surface container.
